title_en: You can complain about a faulty product or poor service
rule_plain: If a product you bought has a fault, or a service you paid for was poor, you can complain. You can file a complaint at the District Consumer Commission. You must file it within two years from the day the problem started.
what_you_can_do: First, call the National Consumer Helpline at 1915 or 1800 11 4000. It is open every day except national holidays, 8 AM to 8 PM.
You can also send your problem by SMS or WhatsApp to 8800001915, or use the NCH app, the web portal or the UMANG app. The helpline sends your problem to the company.
If that does not fix it, file a complaint at the District Consumer Commission. You can file it where you live or work, or where the seller is.
The complaint can be filed online. You must pay the set fee with it.
where_to_get_help: National Consumer Helpline: 1915 or 1800 11 4000 (8 AM to 8 PM). Formal complaints go to the District Consumer Commission.
